fieldNotes.location: Roster address '2280 W McLane St' and coordinates were wrong (GEOMETRIC_CENTER, landed in residential Osceola). Web research found the real address: 1027 Warren Ave, Osceola IA 50213. Locked center 41.0238,-93.7860 — a large multi-building meat-processing campus (Osceola Food LLC, Hormel-owned since 1995/1996, originally Jimmy Dean, 900+ employees, 24/7 operations).
fieldNotes.truckGate: A guard booth with an apparent gate arm controls the truck entrance on the SW access road (~41.0221,-93.7872, clearly visible at z20). The campus is enclosed by chain-link perimeter fence (confirmed in Street View). Trucks were observed queued at the checkpoint.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small (~1-vehicle footprint) white booth set beside the truck lane at the SW checkpoint, with a thin barrier line across the lane. Consistent with a 900-employee secured meat plant.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — a staffed guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long SW access road from the public road to the checkpoint and on to the docks easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved holding area inside the gate before the docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide access road and paved aprons leave room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 25-50 band — dock faces with trailers backed in along the south building face plus other faces. Overhead estimate, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ band — very extensive trailer drop yards: a packed south yard (~40-50 trailers), additional trailer rows north of the plant, and trailers at the SW warehouse.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Multiple dedicated trailer-storage lots (south, north, SW warehouse).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Multiple distinct dock banks on different building faces across a multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 6+ buildings including a large SW distribution/cold-storage warehouse connected by the internal access road.
fieldNotes.scale: A truck scale is plausible at the SW checkpoint for a plant of this scale but not positively isolated in imagery; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Plant sits in an industrial area on the edge of Osceola (pop ~5,000) surrounded by farmland — Rural.
